EnablementProgramDefinition.description: Learn how and when to create a Customer Issue Form. After reviewing the training materials, submit a Customer Issue Form from an Order Summary when a valid customer issue arises.
EnablementProgramDefinition.name: Customer Issue Form: Training & Submission

tasks.description: This video walks you through the reason why we have customer issue and how we raise the customer issue form on the customers order so everything is in one place.
tasks.name: Watch a Video on How to Create a Customer Issue Form in Salesforce

tasks.description: This is a visual aid to assist with entering a customer issue. You can also download this to keep for your records.
tasks.name: Review and Download the Training Document

tasks.description: From an Order Summary record, create and submit a Customer Issue Form when a valid customer issue exists. This step is complete once a qualifying Case has been created in Salesforce.
tasks.name: Submit a Customer Issue Form (when applicable)
